cases.note: canonical envelope; ULID id is the SDK norm
hyphenated UUID id — the id is bounds-checked, never schema-checked
identity keys in meta: userId / anonymousId are convention, never required, and the server lifts them onto the event it writes
baseType is the engine's event type, forwarded as its `type`; optional there and here
meta is optional; only clientEventId and typeKey are required
unknown meta keys are stored verbatim; unknown envelope fields are ignored, not rejected

pack-shaped meta: numeric amounts and a bare chain name, because a rule compares the value it is given — the convention dictionary yields to the pack that reads the key (docs/guides/policy-meta-keys.md)

cases.reason: meta serialises to more than 65536 bytes

errors.note: the workspace has no policy engine tenant — provision it; retrying cannot
the policy engine answered an error of its own — an internal failure, or no deployment for this stream in this tenant; its message is relayed in `message`
the policy engine did not answer; retry, then apply your own fail-mode
the policy engine is at capacity; retry with backoff — Retry-After is set when the engine supplied one
the control plane's payload to the engine was refused — our bug, not yours

meta.note: size only — no key is required and none is rejected (§3.1 rule 2)

body.note: transport backstop; exceeding it is 413 payload_too_large, not 422

baseType.note: optional; omitted means the engine sees no `type`
